Open [the set-aside prototype](http://maker:4001/?scenario=archive-bookmark).

On the pasta bookmark:

1. Select **•••**, then **Set aside**.
2. Open **Set aside 1**.
3. Select **Restore to bookmarks**.
4. Return to **All bookmarks**.

Please tell me whether the bookmark disappears and returns as expected, with its details, tags, formatted note, and read-later state intact.

I’ve assumed setting aside is reversible and needs no confirmation. Set-aside bookmarks are hidden from the main collection and its normal search, but remain accessible in their own view.
